item.name: C: card with an expired date (validation error)

exec: pm.test("The date field says the card expired", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.expiry[0]).to.eql("This card has expired."); });

request.description: The date is checked: 10/26 is over. A card is good until the end of the month on it, so 11/26 works all through November 2026.

item.name: C: card with wrong fields (validation errors)

exec: pm.test("Every wrong field is named", function () { var e = pm.response.json().errors; ["number", "holder", "expiry", "cvv"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(e).to.have.property(k); }); });

item.name: C: pay with a QR code (opens the payment, gives the QR text)

exec: pm.test("QR text in the KHQR layout, with the discounted amount", function () { var q = pm.response.json().qr; pm.expect(q.payload).to.match(/^00020101021/); pm.expect(q.payload).to.include("5405" + q.amount.toFixed(2)); pm.expect(q.currency).to.eql("USD"); });

pm.test("Discount is saved on the booking", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.discount_percent).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(d.amount_due).to.be.below(d.total_price); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("pending"); });

request.description: The payment is written to the database as a payment intent. The guest sees the QR code in the app. Nothing is paid yet.

item.name: C: "I have paid" (the server checks the payment in the database)

exec: pm.test("Confirmed and paid with KHQR", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("confirmed"); pm.expect(d.paid).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.payment_detail).to.eql("KHQR"); });

request.description: The server finds the open QR payment in the database, checks it (open, not expired, right booking, right amount) and only then confirms the booking.

item.name: D: pay by card (any card number works)

exec: pm.test("Confirmed, paid with the card, discount applied", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("confirmed"); pm.expect(d.payment_detail).to.eql("Visa ending 4242"); pm.expect(d.amount_due).to.be.below(d.total_price); });

pm.test("The answer never contains the card number or the CVV", function () { var body = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(body).to.not.include("4242 4242"); pm.expect(body.toLowerCase()).to.not.include("cvv"); });

request.description: No bank is called, so any card number works. The payment is saved in the database and checked there. Only the brand and the last 4 digits are kept.

request.description: The payment is simulated, so the refund is a record in the database: the payment is marked refunded.

item.name: 8. Manual only (do NOT run in the collection runner)
Run the automatic jobs now (changes real bookings)

exec: pm.test("Counts come back", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; ["expired_holds", "no_shows", "refunded", "failed"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(d).to.have.property(k); }); });

request.description: DANGER: this changes real bookings. It cancels old holds, and after 12:00 on the day after check-in it marks guests as NO-SHOW and refunds their online payments. Run it by hand, only on a database you can lose. Never put it in a collection run.
